metadata.prompt:
Implemented in src/db.rs (lines 1299-1422):

1. DeleteSummary struct (line 231-236):
   - Moved outside impl block (Rust requirement)
   - Fields: node_title (String), edges_deleted (usize)
   - Added to lib.rs exports for use in main.rs

2. delete_edge(from_id, to_id) -> Result<()> (lines 1299-1345):
   - Uses .optional()? pattern to check existence without panic
   - On missing edge, queries outgoing edges from source node
   - Returns helpful error: "Node X has edges to: Y, Z" or "has no outgoing edges"
   - Deletes with: diesel::delete(table.filter(from.eq()).filter(to.eq()))

3. delete_node(node_id, dry_run) -> Result<DeleteSummary> (lines 1347-1422):
   - Validates node exists with helpful error message
   - Counts edges with: .filter(from.eq(id).or(to.eq(id))).count()
   - Early return on dry_run with summary (no mutations)
   - Cascade delete order:
     a. decision_edges (both directions)
     b. decision_context
     c. session_nodes
     d. UPDATE decision_sessions SET root_node_id = NULL
     e. UPDATE command_log SET decision_node_id = NULL
     f. UPDATE roadmap_items SET outcome_node_id = NULL
     g. DELETE decision_nodes WHERE id = node_id

Key Diesel patterns used:
- .optional()? for existence checks
- .or() for compound filters
- diesel::update().set(column.eq::<Option<i32>>(None)) for nullable FK cleanup
